tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search AL-KARA bilingual (Turkish & Arabic) cosmetics & personal care catalog with TRY prices, stock, GTIN barcodes, and GCC air-cargo eligibility.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full product details (title, short description, TRY price, ÜTS barcode verification, FAQ, safety notes, shipping & return policies) by ID, SKU, GTIN, slug, or title.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get canonical AL-KARA store metadata, legal registration (BASMA GLOBAL LOJİSTİK LİMİTED ŞİRKETİ), Türkiye & GCC shipping policies, PayTR payment rules, and optional llms.txt markdown summary.

tools.name: check_gulf_shipping
tools.description: Verify GCC air-shipping eligibility (SA, AE, QA, KW, BH, OM) via BASMA Global & SMSA Express (4-7 business days) and flag restricted items (colognes, perfumes, acetone, aerosols).
